modules.title: Microfrontends
modules.note: Order and scope follow the draft roadmap in docs/E09-microfrontends-course.md; all ten lessons are kept and every misconception of the draft is covered (mf-makes-faster, mf-means-module-federation, host-bundles-remote, shared-is-automatic, remote-exports-change-freely, shared-store-is-easy), plus extra misconceptions added by this roadmap for lessons that had none in the draft. Facts about tools (versions, packages, deprecations, shared-option behavior) come from content/frontend-architecture/sources.md, checked 2026-10-06; behavior at runtime (request order, mismatch behavior, host behavior on failure, bytes and requests) must be recorded from the example project in content/frontend-architecture/examples/ (M1), not written by hand. Only widgets that exist today are listed in plannedStepKinds (E09 section Interactions available); the better engine is named in interaction.engine with a fallback that uses those kinds. Lessons are written in parallel, so dependsOn lists only what a lesson needs from earlier ones: Lesson ids are stable folder names. dependsOn is minimal: contracts-01, routing-01 and styles-01 need only host-remote-01, so they can be written in parallel.

interaction.pattern: Behavior-checked design: team situations sorted into monolith, modular monolith or microfrontends, with a consequence shown per wrong choice
interaction.fallback: predict per situation: pick the structure, then see the consequence

interaction.pattern: Matching: each requirement (independent deploy, shared state, style isolation, SEO) matched to the techniques that satisfy it
interaction.fallback: predict per requirement: which techniques satisfy it

interaction.pattern: Be the machine: order the network requests of the first load, checked against a request log recorded from the example project
interaction.fallback: predict the request order one position at a time, with the recorded log as the answer

interaction.pattern: Break it first: cause the invalid hook call with two copies of React, fix it with a singleton share, then change requiredVersion on a mismatch and observe
interaction.fallback: predict the recorded output of each configuration; fillBlanks for the shared block

interaction.pattern: Incident: a remote renames an export; the learner predicts what breaks at runtime and where a check would have caught it
interaction.fallback: predict the runtime result of each change, then fillBlanks for the pre-deploy check

interaction.pattern: Behavior-checked: scenarios (click, reload, deep link) that must land on the right screen
interaction.fallback: predict the screen for each scenario

interaction.pattern: Two timelines: change the shape of a shared store in one remote and see which other remote breaks and when
interaction.fallback: predict which deploy breaks for each communication choice

interaction.pattern: Break it first: a global button rule in one remote restyles the host; then apply isolation options and compare their costs
interaction.fallback: predict which elements a rule restyles; fillBlanks for the isolation setup

interaction.pattern: Incident: a remote that took down checkout; the learner predicts what the host does when the remote fails to load and when a release is cached
interaction.fallback: predict the host behavior recorded from the example project

interaction.pattern: Meter: bytes and requests while toggling sharing and preloading, with values recorded from the example project
interaction.fallback: predict the recorded numbers for each toggle combination
